activity.notes: Representative year for Rutherford's nuclear model of the atom, developed from scattering measurements and published in 1911.

sources.title: Nobel Prize — history of particles
sources.citation_text: NobelPrize.org states that Rutherford's 1911 paper explained scattering by concentrating atomic mass in a small nucleus, marking the birth of nuclear physics.
